set.body: Make codec execution a first-class, dependency-free Scala 3 capability in the generic Zarr kernel. Replace the current gzip-specific reader argument, browser hard-coding, and separate JVM writer match with one compiled codec-program model and explicit platform runtimes. Prove third-party extension on JVM and Scala.js, then rehearse standalone consumption. This epic does not add Zstandard or Blosc to the core, mutation, Zarr v2, or NeuroArchive analytical layouts. Completion requires both-platform tests, Python differential fixtures, and a recorded fast-codec admission decision.
set.title: Epic: Zarr Z6 executable codec architecture and extraction gate
